items.title: New Site-to-Site VPN connections will default to recommended cryptography
items.summary: Starting March 1, 2027, new AWS Site-to-Site VPN connections will default to only the recommended cryptographic algorithms (IKEv2, AES256-GCM-16, SHA2-384, and Diffie-Hellman group 20). Existing connections are unaffected. Learn what changes, how to check whether you are affected, and how to audit and migrate your existing tunnels before the change.
items.creator: Durgesh Potnis
